SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT

SELECT INVESTMENT_TYPE as investmentType, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, SUM(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalActualAmount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY INVESTMENT_TYPE ORDER BY totalPlannedAmount DESC

SELECT INVESTMENT_INDUSTRY as investmentIndustry, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, SUM(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalActualAmount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY INVESTMENT_INDUSTRY ORDER BY totalPlannedAmount DESC

SELECT INVESTMENT_REGION as investmentRegion, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, SUM(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalActualAmount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY INVESTMENT_REGION ORDER BY totalPlannedAmount DESC

SELECT PROJECT_STATUS as projectStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT), 2) as percentage, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY PROJECT_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT INVESTMENT_STAGE as investmentStage, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT), 2) as percentage, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY INVESTMENT_STAGE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT), 2) as percentage, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE RISK_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT), 2) as percentage, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY APPROVAL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, '%Y-%m') as period,
TO_CHAR(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
COUNT(*) as projectCount, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTOR_ENTERPRISE_ID) as investorCount, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID) as investeeCount, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT WHERE INVESTMENT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND INVESTMENT_START_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND INVESTMENT_START_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY period

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, '%Y-%m') as period,
TO_CHAR(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as plannedAmount, SUM(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as actualAmount, AVG(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as avgPlannedAmount, AVG(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as avgActualAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT WHERE INVESTMENT_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND INVESTMENT_START_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND INVESTMENT_START_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(INVESTMENT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY period

SELECT INVESTMENT_TYPE as investmentType, COUNT(*) as projectCount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate, AVG(ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE) as avgActualReturnRate, AVG(CASE WHEN ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE IS NOT NULL AND EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE > 0 THEN ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE / EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE * 100 ELSE NULL END) as returnRateAchievementRatio, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, SUM(ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalActualAmount FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT WHERE PROJECT_STATUS IN ('COMPLETED', 'EXECUTING') GROUP BY INVESTMENT_TYPE ORDER BY avgActualReturnRate DESC

SELECT RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as projectCount, SUM(PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalPlannedAmount, AVG(EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE) as avgExpectedReturnRate, AVG(ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE) as avgActualReturnRate, SUM(CASE WHEN PROJECT_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedProjects, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN PROJECT_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as failureRate FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE RISK_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT PROJECT_ID as projectId, PROJECT_NAME as projectName, PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT as plannedAmount, ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT as actualAmount, INVESTMENT_PROGRESS as progress, EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE as expectedReturnRate, ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE as actualReturnRate, PROJECT_STATUS as projectStatus, CASE WHEN ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE IS NOT NULL AND EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE > 0 THEN ACTUAL_RETURN_RATE / EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE * 100 ELSE NULL END as returnRateAchievementRatio, CASE WHEN ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT > 0 THEN ACTUAL_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT / PLANNED_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT * 100 ELSE NULL END as investmentAmountAchievementRatio FROM INVESTMENT_PROJECT WHERE INVESTOR_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investorEnterpriseId} ORDER BY INVESTMENT_START_DATE DESC
